answer: Every new identity must win a sealed-bid slot auction: each epoch only 20 slots open, and the reserve price starts at 50 POA, rising 15% for every slot taken. Winning bids are burned, so a sybil farm of ten fake accounts pays about 1,000 POA that no lagoon of cheap wallets can recoup. Validators check burn receipts on-chain, and a comet-like spike of registrations from one funder triggers a basalt-hard freeze on its payouts.
